content.comment_body: Is the new [product_name] [version_no] software still not compatible with MacOS Catalina (10.15)? The setup shows an error during installation.

[product_name] [version_no] has been tested by [company_name] only with the following Mac operating systems: Mac OS X 10.8 Mountain Lion, Mac OS X 10.9 Mavericks, Mac OS X 10.10 Yosemite, Mac OS X 10.11 El Capitan, Mac OS X 10.12 Sierra, Mac OS X 10.13 High Sierra, and Mac OS X 10.14 Mojave.

According to the information posted on the [company_name] website: [product_name] software installation instructions for Mac OS X specify the following: After downloading, double-click Setup. Make sure you have Java 1.5 or later, available from Oracle. The compressed installer should be recognized and expanded automatically by Stuffit Expander; otherwise, manually expand using Stuffit Expander 6.0 or newer. If there are issues launching the installer after expanding, confirm it was expanded with Stuffit Expander. For persistent problems, contacting technical support is recommended.

analysis.insight_summary: Users experience compatibility issues when installing [product_name] [version_no] on MacOS Catalina (10.15). Responses clarify that official support and testing is limited to older MacOS versions up to Mojave (10.14), resulting in confusion and frustration for users seeking compatibility with current operating systems.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect the latest version of [product_name] to work seamlessly with new MacOS releases. They look for clear support information and compatibility with the latest operating system updates.
